layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Wepresent PiLoT,a unified framework that tackles UAV-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based ego and target geo-localization. Conventional ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proaches rely on decoupled pipelines that fuse GNsS and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Visual-Inertial Odometry(ViO) for ego-pose estimation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and active sensors like laser rangefinders for target local-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ization. However, these methods are susceptible to failure

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in GNSS-denied environments and incur substantial hard-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ware costs and complexity. PiLoT breaks this paradigm

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by directly registering live video stream against a geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: referenced 3D map. To achieve robust, accurate, and real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time performance,we introduce three key contributions:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1） a Dual-Thread Engine that decouples map rendering

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from core localization thread, ensuring both low latency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while maintaining drift-free accuracy; 2) a large-scale syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thetic dataset with precise geometric annotations (camera

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pose,depth maps). This dataset enables the training of a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lightweight network that generalizes in a zero-shot manner

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from simulation to real data; and 3) a Joint Neural-Guided

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Stochastic-Gradient Optimizer(JNGO) that achieves robust

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: convergence even under aggressive motion.Evaluations

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on comprehensive public and newly collected benchmarks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: show that PiLoToutperforms state-of-the-art methods while

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: running over 25 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson Orin platform.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To conquer these challenges,we propose PiLoT,a new

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paradigm for UAV-based ego and target localization. Pi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: LoT is built upon three key technical contributions, each

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designed to address a side of the impossible triangle. First,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: we introduce a dual-thread framework to decouple local-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ization from map rendering. A Render Thread generates

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a geo-referenced synthetic view on-the-fly，while a con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: current Localization Thread registers the incoming video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream against this view in a feature space. This design

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ensures that every query frame is constrained by dynami-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cally updated geo-anchors that follows the UAV's perspec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive, which is the key to achieve drift-free performance.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: If a UAV with a single monocular camera could instantly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: localize itself in the world and geolocate everything it sees,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it would unlock a new era of autonomy, enabling true-to-life

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: digital twins,AR/VR applications,reliable navigation,and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: embodied AI for UAV. The mainstream approaches 6, 24]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tackle the problem with a decoupled pipeline: localiz-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing the UAV using visual-inertial odometry(VIO） fused

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with GNSS,and subsequently employing active sensors like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: laser rangefinders for target acquisition (e.g., DJI Matrice 4

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Series).However, this paradigm suffers from two critical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limitations:its reliance on GNSS makes it fragile in denied

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or degraded environments,and its laser-based targeting is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: costly, cumbersome,and restricted to a single point.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To validate our approach and beneft the research

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: community,we introduce a new, comprehensive bench-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mark suite for UAV-based ego and target geo-localization.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our benchmark comprises both challenging real-world se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quences and large-scale synthetic data, specifically de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: signed to test robustness against severe weather and light-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing variations,aggressive motion,and long-term flights.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Extensive experiments on public dataset and this bench-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mark demonstrate that our method substantially outper-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: forms state-of-the-art vision-based approaches in both ego

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and target geo-localization. Furthermore,we validate its

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: practical viability by deploying it on an NVIDIA Jetson

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Orin, where it achieves real-time performance with 25 FPS.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we argue for a fundamental paradigm

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shift away from these decoupled, sensor-heavy systems.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Our core idea is to reformulate UAV-based ego and target

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: geo-localization as a unified pixel-to-3D registration prob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lem.By continuously registering the live UAV video stream

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: against a global 3D map (Google Earth for example), our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: system inherently recovers the UAV 6-DoF pose and geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coordinates of any given pixel in the query image.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UAV-based Ego localization. UAV-based ego localization

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aims to estimate the 6-DoF pose in a global coordinate.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: While SLAM and VIO methods [5,21] are robust for lo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cal state estimation,they are prone to drift in the absence

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of a global reference,limiting their universal applicabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity for UAVs. To achieve drift-free localization,a domi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nant paradigm is to register the UAV's view against a geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: referenced map.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, realizing such a system is non-trivial, as it re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quires resolving the fundamental trade-offs between accu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: racy,robustness and real-time performance,often termed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the “impossible triangle". This challenge is profoundly am-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plified by the demanding conditions of aerial deployment,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specifically: 1) Drift-Free Accuracy. While VIO/SLAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods [5,6,21,24] could provide smooth localization,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: they inherently accumulate drift over long-duration flights.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2）Environmental and Motion Robustness. Localiza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion is challenged by severe appearance variations (e.g.,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: day-to-night, seasonal changes) between the captured video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the reference map. Concurrently,aggressive 6-DoF

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UAV motion can cause large inter-frame displacements, ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ceeding the basin of convergence of standard optimizers.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3） Real-time Performance. Recovering a globally con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sistent pose per frame is computationally intensive,cre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ating a significant bottleneck for learning-based match-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ers [9, 23, 25, 27, 29, 38] on resource-constrained onboard

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson Orin).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Second, we develop a custom AirSim-Cesium-Unreal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: engine simulator,and build a new, million-scale synthetic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset by simulating UAV trajectories over vast photoreal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: istic global terrains.By providing calibrated geometric su-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pervision (metric depth,verified poses) across diverse con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ditions (weather, lighting),our dataset compels the network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to learn features grounded in stable 3D geometry. Exper-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: iments confirm that these domain-invariant geometric cues

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enable our UAV-specific network to achieve zero-shot gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eralization on real-world data.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Third,we propose a Joint Neural-Guided Stochastic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Gradient Optimizer (JNGO) that performs pixel-to-3D reg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: istration of the query frame. At its core, JNGO optimizes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the camera pose by aligning the query frame with the pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: jection of a reference 3D map in a shared feature space. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: handle aggressive UAV motions, JNGO synergizes stochas-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tic and gradient-based optimization for effective global ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ploration and local refinement. Specifically,it first gener-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ates a multitude of initial pose hypotheses. Each hypoth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: esis is then refined in parallel via a gradient-based opti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mization that maximizes feature alignment, an operation we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: efficiently implement in CUDA.By repeating this process

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across multiple feature levels, JNGO achieves robust, real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time convergence even under extreme inter-frame displace-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments of up to 10 meters and 10 degrees of yaw.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Early methods used 2D satellite imagery [19,28, 32],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: yielding only 3-DoF pose (latitude, longitude,and yaw),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and remain limited to 2D maps and simplified top-down as-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sumptions．To recover the full 6-DoF pose,recent works

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have turned to 3D maps [23,25,27,38]. These meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UAV-Oriented Visual Localization Datasets. Although

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: recent visual localization methods have made significant

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: progress, they remain largely tailored to ground-level tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Models trained on such data often fail in aerial domains,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: highlighting the need for UAV specific datasets. As de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tailed in Tab. 1, while many [8,15,17,34,36,37,40,43]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: offer photorealism, they often lack the scale and complete

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: geometric ground truth (e.g., 6-DoF poses,metric depth)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: needed for robust training. Even recent efforts with geo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metric data [17,34] are limited in city scale and viewpoint

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: variety,making them insufficient for sequential geometric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supervision.To address the lack of structured UAV training

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods typically initialize the pose via retrieval [1,3,12] or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sensor priors,and then refine it through either matching-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based [9,20,26,29,41] or direct alignment approaches

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [13,16,22, 27,39]. Matching-based methods are compu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tationally too expensive and time-consuming for resource-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constrained UAVs [9,20,26,29,41]. Alternatively， di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rect alignment methods,such as photometric optimiza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion [16,22,39],are highly sensitive to outdoor illumi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nation,whereas feature-metric optimization provides bet-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ter robustness but remains initialization-sensitive and gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eralizes poorly to aerial UAV views [13,27]. Our uni-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fied pixel-to-3D framework mitigates initialization sensitiv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity and closes the aerial domain gap via large-scale, map-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grounded training.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For sequential video localization, a naive strategy is to ren-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: der a reference view from the last frame and perform pose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: refinement for the current frame. This linear dependency

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: creates an inherent temporal bottleneck, where the localiza-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion engine is forced to stall until the rendering task com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pletes.Instead of this conventional linear pipeline,we pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pose a decoupled dual-thread architecture that synchronizes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: map rendering and pose optimization in parallel (Fig. 2).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Given a geo-referenced 3D map

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a monocular video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with known intrinsics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ,and a single pose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prior for the first frame

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ，we address the problem

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of UAV-based ego localization and target geo-localization

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: without aid from GNSS and IMU. Specifically, our goals

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are twofold: 1) estimate T; for every query frame,and 2)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enable precise pixel-to-geo projection that maps any query

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on frame

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to its real-world coordi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nates (lon,lat,alt).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Within this framework,a common strategy to handle

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rapid motion is to render multiple views around the last

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: estimated pose, thereby expanding the search region. Our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: system instead strategically renders a single reference an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chor and leverages a one-to-many strategy. This approach

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: refines a swarm of pose hypotheses against the shared ren-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dering,achieving a wide search range without multiple ref-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erence viewpoints. The two threads coordinate this process

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: UAV-based Target Geo-localization. UAV-based target

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: geo-localization determines the 3D world coordinates of a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target from an image. A primary approach relies on ge-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ometric principles,combining camera models with UAV

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: poses to infer target coordinates [4,42]． This method is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: highly sensitive to the quality of the pose estimate. To im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prove accuracy, 3D map-based geolocation [36] has become

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a mainstream approach,using techniques like rendering-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based matching and DSM projection to obtain precise tar-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: get coordinates. While accurate,these methods are of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ten bottlenecked by the need for computationally expensive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rendering-based matching or tight coupling with a non-real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time ego-localization pipeline. This prevents them from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieving the millisecond-level response required for dy-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: namic targeting applications, a gap our work aims to fill.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a joint neural-guided stochastic-gradient optimizer that en-

layout_dets.text: sures robust convergence under fast motion conditions.Ex-

layout_dets.text: the-art accuracy while operating at over 25 FPS on embed-

layout_dets.text: ded platforms.We believe this work not only advances the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: field of vision-based localization for UAVs under GNSS-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: denied conditions,but also provides valuable insights for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: localization in other robotic platforms.
